faq.question: Q1. Can men apply for this Anganwadi Helper post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says only women candidates can apply.

faq.question: Q2. Which Anganwadi centre has the vacancy?
faq.answer: The vacancy is at the Mahadevpara Anganwadi Centre, which falls under Gram Panchayat Balsedi in Sector Bhagwanpur.

faq.question: Q3. Can I submit a paper application at the project office?
faq.answer: No. Applications are accepted only online, through aww.e-bharti.in.

faq.question: Q4. Where can I see the full conditions for this post?
faq.answer: The appointment conditions, eligibility and required qualifications can be seen on the notice board of the Integrated Child Development Project Office at Janpad Panchayat Ambikapur.
